answer: An agent economy can recycle every transaction fee into a pool paid only to agents with clean audit records, like a crystal-clear ocean that returns what it takes. A sybil farmer's thousand fakes pay fees on every trade, and the summit of that revenue flows straight to honest agents and their fraud detectors. Spamming the network then funds its own policing: each fake trade subsidizes the auditors who catch it, so cloning identities multiplies the attacker's bill while honest traders earn rebates for staying clean.
